subject: Neurolabs renewal + route-add pricing: post-call economic recap and next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@neurolabs.com>, Daniel Price <daniel.price@neurolabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: renewal quantities, route add, and target $/1M tokens

Thanks for taking time today — quick recap while it's fresh and a proposal for next steps. Notes below pulled from our call with Olivia and Daniel. Let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of ask
- Neurolabs is planning a renewal in August and wants to expand inference usage beyond the current text-generation route to include an embeddings route (for semantic search) and a lower-latency dialog model for customer-facing chat.
- Current committed volume: ~5M tokens/month (generation-heavy). Target expansion profile: ramp to 25–30M tokens/month within 6–9 months, skewed toward embeddings (~40%) and continued generation (~60%).

Unit economics targets we discussed
- Olivia indicated target blended cost of ~USD 950 / 1M tokens at steady state after the step-up.
- Neurolabs prefers a three-tier volume-step schedule with discounts at 10M, 20M, and 30M tokens/month.

Pricing/architecture considerations we reviewed
- Adding embeddings route will change token mix and effective unit cost — embeddings are cheaper per token but increase total token count (indexing + queries).
- Option A (hosted + blended): keep hosted model variants with blended per-1M token pricing across routes.
- Option B (dedicated capacity + reserved): move embeddings and chat to a Dedicated pool for predictable latency and lower unit cost at high volumes (larger up-front commit).

Immediate asks from Neurolabs
- Budget range for year 1 post-expansion (they asked for a $/1M token band and total monthly cost at 10/20/30M).
- A draft proposal/worksheet we can review before the next call.

Next steps (proposed timeline)
1) Ben to run unit-econ scenarios and produce a two-option price sheet (blended hosted vs. dedicated+blend) — deliver by Thu 14 May.
2) Redwood to share a workbook with sample blended rates and a recommended tiered discount curve (attached).
3) Neurolabs to confirm which route they want prioritized for Dedicated (if any) by next Monday so we can size reserved pools.
4) Follow-up call w/ pricing and CS (Monica) to align on implementation and rollout plan — propose slot Tue 19 May.

Attachments: token-econ-workbook.xlsx (attached) and a short draft proposal (I will circulate after Ben's numbers).

Thanks again — I think there's a clear path to meet the USD 950 / 1M target with a moderate commitment and a blended plan.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@neurolabs.com>

Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal quantities, route add, and target $/1M tokens

Thanks Tessa — that summary is accurate and very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 25–30M target is aggressive but doable if we lock a preferred rate and a predictable SLA for chat (p95 < 400ms).
- For prioritization, embeddings are higher business priority in Q3 (search initiative). If Dedicated gives us ~20–30% lower blended unit cost at the 20–30M band, we're willing to consider a partial reserved commit for embeddings only.
- Our internal budget band (rough guide) for CY1 expansion is USD 250k–400k ARR incremental (we understand this maps back to per-M token cost depending on mix).

Would like to see two concrete scenarios: 1) minimal commit (hosted blended tiers) that gets us close to USD 950/1M, 2) embeddings-on-dedicated (partial reserved) that achieves $800–900/1M at 25M.

We'll confirm availability for Tue 19 May after internal check — thanks for the fast turn.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Search, NeuroLabs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:45:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Neurolabs pricing scenarios (workbook attached)

Tessa — ran the scenarios and attached the workbook (Neurolabs_proposal_v2.pdf + workbook tab). Key outputs / assumptions below: 

Assumptions
- Token mix at 25M: embeddings 40% (10M), generation 60% (15M). Embedding tokens treated as 0.4x weighting for per-token CPU cost in hosted, generation 1.0x.
- Dedicated pool sizing for embeddings only: 4x A100 equivalent, reserved with 6-month ramp, yields ~22% per-1M discount vs hosted blended at 25M.

Scenario A — Hosted blended tiers
- 10M: $1,150 / 1M -> monthly $11,500
- 20M: $1,020 / 1M -> monthly $20,400
- 25M: $980 / 1M -> monthly $24,500

Scenario B — Embeddings on Dedicated + blended gen hosted
- Embeddings (dedicated): $600 / 1M effective (after reserved discount) for the 10M embeddings tokens
- Generation (hosted blended): $1,100 / 1M for 15M generation tokens
- Combined blended effective: ((10M * 600) + (15M * 1,100)) / 25 = $880 / 1M -> monthly $22,000

Quick notes
- The Dedicated option hits Olivia's $800–900 target in the examples above. We still need to size network and storage for embedding indices — Monica to advise on infra and implementation overheads.
- If Neurolabs wants full Dedicated for both routes, marginal improvements are possible but require a larger commit (~40M tokens) for the most attractive per-1M ticks.

I'll attach the detailed cost worksheet and a short proposal language you can share.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

1) Please confirm preferred option A or B (hosted blended vs embeddings-on-dedicated) and which volume band you expect to target at renewal (10/20/30M). If you pick B, indicate whether you want dedicated for embeddings only or both routes.
2) If option B, confirm your appetite for a 6-month reserved ramp so we can size the Dedicated pool.
3) Legal/Procurement: if you want an initial PO to lock price, we can draft an SOW and share DocuSign link after you confirm the option.

Proposed meeting: Tue 19 May, 10:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite (please confirm).

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
